title: AI-enabled quality assurance for point-of-care EEG cap positioning by inexperienced users — reproduction code and data
description: De-identified participant-level measurements, condition assignments, blinded ratings and analysis code reproducing every clinical result, table and figure in the accompanying Epilepsia manuscript, together with the post hoc forward-modelling analysis reported as Supplementary Material 5.
